base: Whole estate accounted for by the executor or administrator, excluding property not ranked as assets (58 O.S. § 527(A)).

schedules.text: 5% of the first $1,000; 4% of the next $5,000; 2.5% of all above $6,000 (58 O.S. § 527(A)).
schedules.capNote: Further allowance for extraordinary services may not exceed the commission amount (§ 527(A)); co-representatives share one fee (§ 527(B)).
